title: X-704 White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the Nolan X-704 White is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort across highway and urban riding. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1630g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~86 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and a glove-friendly Microlock2 (Micrometric Ratchet) retention system.

product_details.description: Nolan X-704 modular with N-Com ready.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular chin bar; fits most head shapes but may feel tight on very large heads due to fixed shell size.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nolan X-704 White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Nolan's Modular lineup, the X-704 White brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Nolan X-704 White represents Nolan's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nolan X-704 White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
